Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: When you come over again, French-- Canuck Kweebec gives you no mind. He's too enamored with his pond. Yet, it's not like he hasn't noticed you at all.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: When he next speaks, you notice that he's keeping up the accent of a Frenchman. It is, however, significantly more demure than before. Some habits die hard, apparently.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: I have been thinking. And I have realised that this French thing has not been working well.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: I wanted to feel like ... someone, before I forever take root. Someone interesting, if I am not able to attain any degree of importance in time.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: You hear a deep sigh before he turns around to face you, except his eyes remain downcast.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: For most of my life, I was as unremarkable as you can imagine a Kweebec to be. So, I have assumed une personnalité.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: I know. « Being French » does not sound like one on its own, but it is eye-catching, non ? Les Français are met with as much respect as dérision, even if you only hear about the second one on Kweebdrasil.

Line.Text: Who, outside of it, cares about my backwater ? Or-- non, who thinks more of it than a joke ? Even if les plébéiens make many comments about France too, it is still seen as a place of high culture and high fashion.

Choices.Text: Who cares? Just own up to it.
Don't let a bunch of strangers and their presumptions make you upend your whole life.
But Quebec is also pretty cool. You have... uh... hmm...
